title: ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search
abstract: arXiv:2604.12762v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing person search methods assume access to complete visual queries or exhaustive tracking, yet real-world witness accounts are vague, partial, and spread across cameras and time. We introduce ARGOS (Agentic Retrieval with Grounded Observational Search), a benchmark and agent framework that recasts multi-camera person search from one-shot retrieval on a complete query into interactive reasoning from partial clues. To our knowledge, ARGOS is the first interactive benchmark to couple witness dialogue with camera-network topology, requiring an agent to plan, question, and eliminate under information asymmetry.   An ARGOS agent receives a vague witness statement and must decide what to ask, when to invoke spatial or temporal tools, and how to interpret ambiguous natural-language responses, all within a limited turn budget. To ground reasoning in physical constraints, the agent accesses a Spatio-Temporal Topology Graph (STTG) en

translated_title: ARGOS：智能体化多摄像头行人搜索中的“谁、在哪里、何时”
translated_abstract: 现有的行人搜索方法假设可以获得完整的视觉查询或详尽的跟踪，然而现实世界中的目击者描述往往是模糊、不完整的，且分散在不同的摄像头和时间中。我们提出了ARGOS（Agentic Retrieval with Grounded Observational Search，基于落地观测搜索的智能体检索），这是一个基准测试与智能体框架，它将多摄像头行人搜索从基于完整查询的一次性检索，重新定义为一项基于部分线索的交互式推理任务。据我们所知，ARGOS是首个将目击者对话与摄像头网络拓扑相结合的交互式基准测试，要求智能体在信息不对称的条件下进行规划、提问和排除。ARGOS智能体接收一份模糊的目击者陈述，必须在有限的对话轮次预算内决定该问什么、何时调用空间或时间工具，以及如何解读含糊的自然语言回应。为了使推理立足于物理约束，智能体可以访问时空拓扑图（STTG）……
tldr: ARGOS是首个将目击者对话与摄像头网络拓扑相结合的交互式行人搜索基准与智能体框架，要求智能体在有限轮次和信息不对称条件下基于模糊线索进行提问、调用时空工具并排除候选目标，从而将多摄像头行人搜索从一次性检索转变为交互式推理。
en_tdlr: ARGOS is the first interactive benchmark and agent framework that couples witness dialogue with camera-network topology, requiring an agent to plan, question, and eliminate under information asymmetry within a limited turn budget, thereby recasting multi-camera person search from one-shot retrieval into interactive reasoning from partial clues.
